get.description: Replays committed events after ``after`` or a valid ``Last-Event-ID``. Frame identifiers are the per-run durable sequence numbers; heartbeats are comments while idle; resume never duplicates or skips a retained event. A sequence ahead of the durable frontier is rejected with 409 before streaming begins.
